title: CUTN Recruitment 2026 - Apply for Junior Research Fellow/ Project Fellow Posts
description: Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN) has released the official notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow/ Project Fellow Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the Post Graduation can grab this chance and apply for the CUTN Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last date of application....
